body:
# Overview

Randomemenoscraft adds an assortment of random additions to Minecraft. Randomemenoscraft is made by me and my friend, and it started out as a little project with us asking random peopple what to add to Minecraft, and this is what came out, so download our mod and your Minecraft experience will be one you won't forget (hopefully). :)

It is still a work in progress, that currently includes, Tungsten and Tungstenite tools and armor, Emerald armor, Bacon, liquid mercury, and sharks.

## Details about current additions

**Tungsten and Tungstenite tools and armor**: Tungsten and Tungstenite are brand new materials that you can obtain. Tungsten is found below Y=-30 and when made into tools and armor, is better than diamond but worse than netherite. Tungstenite on the otherhand, is a combination of tungsten and diamonds and when turned into armor, is better than netherite.

**Liquid mercury**: Liquid mercury is a new liquid that hurts you if you go in it and cannot be found naturally but instead crafted with gold iron and a bucket.

**Bacon**: Bacon is a food source that is a little worse than cooked pork and can be turned into golden bacon that is as good as a golden apple. God bacon (creative only for now) gives extremely OP buffs like strength 10 and water breathing 5.

**Emerald Armor**: Emerald armor is a armor better than iron but worse than diamond and each piece gives you hero of the villiage which lowers prices.

**Sharks**: Sharks are found in ocean biomes and can be tamed with raw fish.

**Bronze**: A new material that is made with copper and iron, 4 copper on the top and 4 iron on the bottom. Bronze is a little better than iron but worse than diamond. Bronze can make tools and armor. To make the tools you must make a bronze rod with two bronze ingots.

**Copper tools and armor**: Copper is now useful! With copper you can make armor which is a little worse than iron armor. Copper tools, are made with copper ingots and copper rods, which are made with two copper ingots and the tools made with copper ingots.
